text:
Jesper Boqvist is back where his career started, a New Jersey depth forward in 11.3 minutes a night after a Stanley Cup with Florida in 2025. Seven goals in 23 games is more than he scored all of last season with the Panthers (4 in 73), and his 2.76 points per 60 would be a career best by a distance.

The finishing explains most of it. He has 7 goals on 3.9 expected (the quality of his chances, in goals), and he is scoring on 23% of his shots after 6% last season. Our estimate of his true rate is about 13%. Evolving-Hockey had him around replacement level last year, with his team's offence in the bottom 6% of forwards when he played.

The Devils do control play with him out there: 57.1% of 5v5 shot attempts and 55.5% of the expected goals, though that's in line with the team rather than above it. His minutes have slid to 10.6 over his last ten, and two of the last three nights were under nine. The goals have been a bonus. The role is fourth-line, and the shooting will drift back toward it.
headline: Boqvist's homecoming is running on 23% shooting
